title: Fortémi React
description: Documentation for the fortemi-react packages — @fortemi/core, @fortemi/graph, and @fortemi/react: PGlite data layer, hybrid search, SKOS tagging, and graph tooling.

welcome.headline: Knowledge Management in the Browser
welcome.lead: A React port of Fortémi: a PGlite (PostgreSQL WASM) data layer, hybrid semantic search, W3C SKOS tagging, and graph tooling — with 100% JSON format parity with the Fortémi Rust server.
pillars: @fortemi/core — browser-only data layer: PGlite, single-writer worker, MCP tools, job queue, and hybrid search.
@fortemi/graph — framework-agnostic community-graph layout, filtering, neighborhood expansion, and snapshot serialization.
@fortemi/react — React 19 hooks and FortemiProvider (30 hooks) over @fortemi/core.
checklist: Install @fortemi/react and wrap your app in FortemiProvider.
Use hooks for notes, hybrid search, tags, collections, and SKOS concepts.
Import/export Knowledge Shards for parity with the Fortémi server.
